title: helianthemum guttatum subsp. plantagineum
intro: Helianthemum guttatum subsp. plantagineum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the mind and body, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, such as quercetin and kaempferol, which contribute to its medicinal properties, as well as essential oils that provide its characteristic fragrance and therapeutic effects.
